title: Madonna
notes: Synth-led New York club pop with drum machines, bright melodies and occasional guitars

title: Like a Virgin
notes: Forceful live drums and funk-rooted bass give bright dance-pop a fuller, tougher sound

title: True Blue
notes: Polished pop ranges from dance tracks to ballads, girl-group references and Latin rhythms

title: Like a Prayer
notes: Gospel choir, live-band funk and intimate songwriting broaden her dance-pop sound

title: Erotica
notes: Cool-toned house grooves meet restrained vocals, romantic disillusionment and sexual politics

title: Bedtime Stories
notes: Mellow hip-hop-soul grooves and lush ballads, with one electronic outlier

title: Ray of Light
notes: Atmospheric programmed rhythms, analogue synths and guitars frame searching, contemplative pop.

title: Music
notes: Warped vocals and restless club electronics alternate with acoustic, emotionally direct songs.

title: American Life
notes: Glitch-cut guitars, sparse electronics and fractured vocals frame critiques of fame.
